# QR generator

`qrcode-2.0.4.js` is the unmodified `dist/qrcode.js` from npm package
`qrcode-generator@2.0.4` by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT license; notice retained).
Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Served locally so private RSVP tokens are not sent to an external QR service.
